::: {.content-section}

## Cookies

We use [Cookiebot](https://www.cookiebot.com/) to manage cookie consent.
When you first visit the site, a banner lets you choose which categories of
cookies to allow; scripts that aren't strictly necessary (such as analytics)
only run after you consent.

<script id="CookieDeclaration" src="https://consent.cookiebot.com/0feb0669-f01b-4e38-8750-8132c8216d12/cd.js" type="text/javascript" async></script>

:::

::: {.content-section}

## Analytics

With your consent, we use **Google Analytics** and **Google Tag Manager** to
understand how visitors use the site (pages visited, general location,
device type). This data is aggregated and does not identify you personally.

:::

::: {.content-section}

## Newsletter

If you sign up for the OpenSpace newsletter, the information you enter
(email address, and optionally your name, affiliation, and how you heard
about us) is sent to **Mailchimp**, our email newsletter provider, and used
to send you updates. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any
newsletter email.

:::

::: {.content-section}

## Contact form

The [contact form](/community/contact.qmd) opens your own email client with
a pre-addressed message — the information you enter is sent directly to us
by email and is not stored on this website.

:::

::: {.content-section}

## Questions

If you have questions about this policy, please [get in touch](/community/contact.qmd).

:::
